title: Pandora's Star
author: Hamilton, Peter F.
review:
Biiiigggg sci-fi book. Actually amazed at how much I devoured this considering the size. It's not as dense as I thought and the prose is nice and readable with a good amount of descriptions of the world and landscapes. The characters are also very good and I ended up caring about a lot of them.

This isn't actually as idea heavy as some other sci-fi books, the focus is more about the plot, the world building, and the characters, although there are cool ideas a lot of them stem from the technology developed and how that affects society at large.

Really happy I read this and starting the next big boi immediately.
